title: Scalar multiplication and associativity for realization counits
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and one normalized integral comparison system $D$ [def-trf-integral-comparison-realization-models]. Let $E\xrightarrow\iota L\xrightarrow j M$ be finite coefficient extensions of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, and let $X$ be a scheme with $\ell$ invertible. Write $R_F$ for the recorded reduction functor [def-trf-integral-comparison-sequence-systems], $T_{EF}$ for completed scalar extension from $E$ to $F$ [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension], $S_{EF}$ for its whole-system scalar extension, and $c_{EF,K}:R_F(T_{EF}K)\to S_{EF}(R_EK)$ for the actual scalar realization counit. For each constructible-complete integral complex $K$ over $E$ [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], the scalar multiplication $e$ and system associator $\alpha$ [def-trf-quotient-system-coherence-data] satisfy $c_{EE,K};e_{R_EK}=R_E(\widehat e_K)$ and $c_{LM,T_{EL}K};S_{LM}(c_{EL,K});\alpha_{R_EK}=R_M(\widehat\alpha_K);c_{EM,K}$. Here $\widehat e$ and $\widehat\alpha$ are the ordinary finite-free derived tensor comparisons conjugated by the specified completion maps [lem-weil-normalized-scalar-completion, lem-weil-scalar-extension-composition]. These are equations of entire derived quotient diagrams, including identity embeddings and equal fields, with no finite Tor-amplitude bound.

source.place: lemma-derived-base-change (06YY), lemma-derived-limit-is-ok (0941); agent-extracted scalar normalization step of lem-trf-normalized-integral-scalar-coherence

proof.text: Apply the proved ordinary-model coherence theorem to obtain comparison isomorphisms preserving the specified completion transformations, multiplication, and associator. The coherence theorem proves its tensor-level and localization assertions in a separate module; no new unproved obligation is introduced.

Precompose scalarModelUnit with the ordinary model isomorphism, and substitute its completion and multiplication compatibilities from the first two steps. Cancel scalarCompletionIso at the complete input. This gives b;limit(systemUnit)=completedUnit;adjunctionUnit. Apply reduction to this equation and postcompose with the actual reduction/limit counit. Counit naturality and the left triangle reduce it to c;systemUnit=reduction(completedUnit).

Precompose scalarModelAssociativity with the composite of the two ordinary model comparisons. Naturality and their completion identities replace the initial pair of completion maps by the specified scalarCompletion maps; the derived associator compatibility replaces its other side by the prescribed ordinary associator. Cancel the two scalarCompletionIso components at K and its first completed scalar extension. Naturality of the second realization moves the first realization through it; functoriality then combines the intermediate actual counit into scalar change of c_EL. Apply reduction and its counit to the resulting realized equation. Counit naturality gives c_LM;S_LM(c_EL);systemAssociator = reduction(completedAssociator);c_EM. All equations are of entire diagrams; the argument does not assume finite quotient maps flat and includes identities, equal fields and zero objects.

theorem integralScalarCounitNormalization
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (D : IntegralComparisonSystem.{u} l) :
    (∀ (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
      (X : Scheme.{u}) [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
      (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E X),
      (integralComparisonScalarCounit l E E (AlgHom.id ℚ_[l] E) X
        ((D.coefficient E).system X) ((D.coefficient E).system X)
        ((D.coefficient E).roos X) ((D.scalar E E (AlgHom.id ℚ_[l] E)).model X)).app
          K.obj ≫
        (integralComparisonSystemScalarUnit l E X).hom.app
          (((D.coefficient E).system X).reduction.obj K.obj) =
      ((D.coefficient E).system X).reduction.map
        (integralComparisonScalarUnit l E X K).hom) ∧
    (∀ (E L M : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E]
      [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] [Field L] [Algebra ℚ_[l] L]
      [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] L] [Field M] [Algebra ℚ_[l] M]
      [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] M] (ι : E →ₐ[ℚ_[l]] L) (j : L →ₐ[ℚ_[l]] M)
      (X : Scheme.{u}) [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
      (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E X),
      (integralComparisonScalarCounit l L M j X
        ((D.coefficient L).system X) ((D.coefficient M).system X)
        ((D.coefficient M).roos X) ((D.scalar L M j).model X)).app
          ((integralScalarExtension l E L ι X).obj K.obj) ≫
        (integralComparisonDerivedSequenceScalar l L M j X).map
          ((integralComparisonScalarCounit l E L ι X
            ((D.coefficient E).system X) ((D.coefficient L).system X)
            ((D.coefficient L).roos X) ((D.scalar E L ι).model X)).app K.obj) ≫
        (integralComparisonSystemScalarComposition l E L M ι j X).hom.app
          (((D.coefficient E).system X).reduction.obj K.obj) =
      ((D.coefficient M).system X).reduction.map
          (integralComparisonScalarAssociator l E L ι M j X K).hom ≫
        (integralComparisonScalarCounit l E M (j.comp ι) X
          ((D.coefficient E).system X) ((D.coefficient M).system X)
          ((D.coefficient M).roos X) ((D.scalar E M (j.comp ι)).model X)).app K.obj)
